scope: One predeclared held-GIL Sleep correctness control and one released-GIL Sleep correctness control, in fresh synthetic Python processes only. Independent memory-mapped heartbeat and OS ExecutionDelay snapshots check delivered behavior. No application, GUI, camera, USB, Run, optimization candidate, ETW or machine interval access.
held_expected: heartbeat unchanged during observer window; at least40 held_sleep GIL samples, all on the known native thread ID, no other sampled GIL thread.
released_expected: heartbeat advances at least20 times; zero released_sleep GIL samples. Other Python thread samples may legitimately occur.
limits: Logical correctness controls do not qualify field disturbance, GIL time shares, inference under concurrent frame mutation or native stack completeness.
All controls and failures are retained. No repeat to substitute failure and no lowered gates. Existing CPU/wait failures and frozen plans are untouched.
A future field use would require a separately reviewed/frozen collection plan and actual-load calibration; this preflight does not start or authorize one.
